title: She Fell In Love With A Wolf, And Raised His Two Wolf Children Alone . . .
caption:
Wolf Children (2012): Hana falls for the last wolf man, then raises his two wolf kids alone in the mountains.
A mother must let her children choose between human and wolf.

#wolfchildren #anime #animerecap #animemovie #recap
comment: Would you have let Ame run up the mountain, or kept him home? Why?

segments.say: Hana's husband was a wolf, and one rainy night he died alone in a *drain*.
To see how it got here, go back to a lecture *hall* in Tokyo.
Hana is a poor student, working jobs just to pay for *school*.
One day she spots a stranger with no textbook, taking notes in her *lecture*.
Hana offers to share her lectures, and soon they are *inseparable*.
Her name means flower. Her father wanted her to smile through everything, even his *funeral*.
But one night, he tells her he has a *secret*.
He asks her to close her eyes. When she opens them, he is a *wolf*.
Hana is not afraid. That is what real *love* looks like.
The last Honshu wolf lived alone, until Hana moved in and they built a small *home*.
Their first child, Yuki, is born in the snow, with no doctor and no *midwife*.
The next spring, baby Ame is born on a rainy day. His father steps out, and never comes *home*.
So Hana goes out into the rain to *find* him.
And there, lying in a drain, is the man she *loved*, gone like a stray animal.
She thinks she hears him say, "Take good care of our *children*."
Now she is a mother with nobody to lean *on*.
All he left behind was an old ID card and two wolf *babies*.
Yuki turns into a wolf pup whenever she is cranky, and she is cranky a *lot*.
No parenting book explains a *wolf* baby.
Ame cries all night. Hana cannot sleep, cannot study, cannot *rest*.
She did it all with no *help*.
When they get sick, she cannot take them to a doctor, or a *vet*.
The neighbors scream about the crying, and then child welfare *knocks*.
So she asks her kids one question. Do you want to be people, or *wolves*?
Then she moves them to an old house in the mountains, far from prying *eyes*.
The house is falling apart, but the kids fall in love with the *yard*.
Hana makes one rule. Being wolf children is their little *secret*.
But farming is brutal. Her tomatoes die, and an old farmer says she is not cut out for *this*.
Still, grumpy old Nirasaki secretly teaches her how to dig, plant, and *grow*.
Soon the whole village is helping her, as if she belonged *there*.
Wild boars wreck every field in the valley, but hers is *untouched*.
Then winter comes, and the kids race through the snow as *wolves*.
Then the icy river pulls them under, and Yuki screams for *help*.
Hana drags Ame out of the water, and he is not *breathing*.
Years later, Hana said her heart had stopped. But for Ame, that day was an *awakening*.
Yuki dreams of going to school, so Hana lets her, with one rule: never turn into a *wolf*.
But Yuki is not like other girls. She collects snakes and animal *bones*.
So she hides who she is, and wears a pretty dress to fit *in*.
Then a new boy, Sohei, says Yuki smells like a *dog*.
Cornered, Yuki loses control, turns into a wolf, and tears his *ear*.
Sohei tells everyone a wolf did it, even when nobody *believes* him.
Later he brings her homework, and says wolves are pretty *cool*.
Meanwhile, Ame skips school and spends his days with a wise old fox he calls *Sensei*.
At dinner, Yuki tells him to go to school. Ame says he is a *wolf*.

segments.text: Because I'm a wolf. You are a human. No, I'm not.

segments.say: Then the fight begins, and two wolf siblings try to tear each other *apart*.
That is the price of *freedom*.
Years pass, and a record storm hits. Ame keeps running up the mountain to check on *Sensei*.
Sensei is dying, and Ame wants to take his place. Hana begs him to *stay*.
The next morning, a flood warning goes out. Hana tells Yuki to stay home, but she *goes*.
At school, the parents rush in, until only Yuki and Sohei are *left*.
At home, Ame is gone. Hana runs into the storm in her yellow *raincoat*.
In the fog, Hana hears something huge moving close, and then the ground gives *way*.
Hurt and alone, she crawls through the mud, calling Ame's *name*.
At school, Sohei admits his mother has a new baby, and he feels *forgotten*.
Yuki stops hiding. She tells him the secret she kept for *years*.
Her ears pop out, and Sohei just *smiles*. He knew all along.
Back on the mountain, Hana lies unconscious, and in her dream, she sees *him*.
He tells her she raised their kids *well*.
She wakes, and Ame stands over her, a full grown *wolf*.
He turns and runs up the mountain. "Don't *go*!"
From the cliff, Ame howls at the *sunrise*, and Hana smiles through her tears.
That was her bravest *choice*.
Yuki leaves for boarding school, and Hana stays behind in the old *house*.
Her son guards the mountain now, and somewhere up there, he is *watching*.
